summary: This bill aims to improve access to free school lunches by expanding direct certification for eligible students, providing grants and technical assistance to states and tribal organizations to enhance their direct certification processes, and modifying the community eligibility option to allow more schools to offer free meals to all students.

scores.thoughts: This bill allocates $28,000,000 from the Treasury for direct certification improvement grants and technical assistance related to school lunch programs. This represents a direct increase in government spending.

The bill aims to improve direct certification for school lunch programs, making it easier for eligible children to receive free meals. This expands access to a key social safety net program, even if it doesn't increase the overall benefits per recipient.
